comparison.objective: Select a correctly fitting wrench, loosen a captive nut, and open a released latch arm; candidate tunes and relocks a damper to achieve acceptable repeated stops.
comparison.physical_skill: Tool-size selection, open-end wrench fitting, loosening, and arm swinging versus recessed hex-key insertion, collar fine rotation, counterholding, relocking, and iterative dynamic evaluation.
comparison.success_condition: Requires at least 60° nut backoff, arm at least 85° open, 20 seconds contact-free, and no rounding/force violation. Candidate requires two non-bottoming cycles and retained setting; its rebound, overload, torque, and drift limits remain nonnumeric.
comparison.reason: Both include tool-mediated loosening and rotation, but the tested abilities differ materially: latch release and tool-fit damage avoidance versus closed-loop damper commissioning and lock retention.
